defs.def: a time of great danger, difficulty or confusion when problems must be solved or important decisions must be made 危机；危急关头

ex.s: The call for public engagement with the unthinkable is especially germane in this moment of still-uncontrolled pandemic and economic crises in the world's most technologically advanced nations.
ex.t: 公众参与讨论不可想象之事的呼吁在当今世界最发达的国家仍处于失控的大流行病和经济危机这一时刻尤其相关。

ex.s: The 2008 financial crisis created an unstable job market.
ex.t: 2008年金融危机造成了不稳定的就业市场。

ex.s: It led to a severe food crisis and threatened the livelihood of more than 9.5 million people.
ex.t: 这导致了严重的粮食危机，威胁到超过950万人的生计。

ex.s: To be caught up in such a crisis creates powerful bonds between people, not only between carers and patients, but also between all those who have come from different parts of the world and joined together in a common cause.
ex.t: 身处这样的危机之中，会在人们之间建立起牢固的情感纽带，不仅是照护者与患者之间，也包括那些来自世界各地、为共同事业走到一起的人们之间。

ex.s: Facing Crisis 1 The story of Robinson Crusoe is a very sad survival story.
ex.t: 面对危机：鲁滨逊漂流记的故事是一个非常悲伤的求生故事。

ex.s: Such qualities can help us cope in a crisis, no matter what or where it is.
ex.t: 这些品质可以帮助我们在危机中应对，无论它是什么或在哪里。

ex.s: To tackle this crisis, he chose to study agriculture and received an education at Southwest Agricultural College in Chongqing.
ex.t: 为了应对这场危机，他选择学习农业，并在重庆的西南农业学院接受教育。

defs.def: a time when a problem, a bad situation or an illness is at its worst point 危难时刻；病危期

chunks.cn: 食物危机 / 脸危机 / 财政的危机
